DeepSeek split every rate into OFF-PEAK / PEAK on 2026-08-16 and raised both. This row is the OFF-PEAK rate, which covers 17 of 24 hours; peak (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC) is exactly 2x at $0.44/mtok. Off-peak is published as the standard rate because the page defines the split as "off-peak rates are half of the peak rates" and OpenRouter resells this model at the off-peak number. effective_from is the page last-modified stamp (Sun, 16 Aug 2026 16:00:13 GMT), which falls inside our observation window: the 2026-08-16 13:25 UTC sentinel run still read the prior rate and the 2026-08-17 02:16 UTC run did not. The schema has no variation for a time-of-day rate, so the peak rate is not carried as a record.
